name: Anand Kumar Shrivastav
summary:
Results-driven Data Scientist and Generative AI Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience designing and deploying
Machine Learning and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions across healthcare, financial analytics, and
digital payment fraud detection systems. Strong expertise in LLMs, semantic search, embeddings, vector databases,
predictive modeling, and anomaly detection to build intelligent decision-support systems. Experienced in
developing end-to-end ML and GenAI pipelines including data ingestion, EDA, feature engineering, model training,
evaluation, and production deployment using Python-based microservices. Proven ability to deliver scalable AI
solutions that improve operational efficiency, enhance decision-making, and reduce manual effort through FastAPI,
Docker, and AWS-based cloud deployments.
